Recorded claim:
The current server binds to `127.0.0.1`, embeds its API token in HTML, authenticates by token replay, and can shut down when the browser closes. Before remote exposure, add pairing, revocable per-device sessions, authorization on every action, and service lifetime independent of a window. Tailscale Serve is plausible private HTTPS transport but was not installed/configured. [Task 3]
